steps.summaryReviewDescription: Review your project details before final creation.
steps.completeRequiredFields: Complete the required fields in Project Basics and Project Description before creating the workspace.

basics.title: Project Basics
basics.description: Define the identity and academic context of the PFE workspace.
basics.projectTitleHelper: Use a clear title that describes the solution and its purpose.

description.title: Project Description
description.description: Capture the problem, objective, deliverables, and stakeholders so AI modules can generate accurate project artifacts.
description.problemStatementPlaceholder: Describe the problem, who is affected, and why it matters.
description.problemStatementHelper: Explain the current pain point, limitation, or opportunity. This will be reused to generate the formal problem statement.
description.projectObjectivePlaceholder: State the main goal your project must achieve.
description.projectObjectiveHelper: Write the desired outcome in measurable terms when possible.
description.expectedDeliverablesPlaceholder: e.g. Web app, API, documentation, deployment guide
description.expectedDeliverablesHelper: List the outputs you expect to submit or demonstrate.
description.stakeholdersHelper: Mention people or organizations that use, review, or benefit from the project.
description.internshipCompanyHelper: Leave empty for a purely academic project.
description.industrySectorHelper: This helps tailor examples, risks, and business context.

technical.title: Technical Context
technical.description: Describe how the project will be built so generated artifacts match the real implementation scope.
technical.developmentTypeHelper: Select every platform or technical category that applies to your project.
technical.otherDevelopmentTypePlaceholder: e.g. AR/VR system, embedded system, blockchain application
technical.otherDevelopmentTypeHelper: Specify the real project type if it is not listed above.
technical.technologyStackHelper: Select the frameworks, languages, databases, cloud tools, and AI libraries used in your project.
technical.otherTechnologiesPlaceholder: e.g. Odoo, Figma, MATLAB, Apache Kafka
technical.otherTechnologiesHelper: Use this only for real tools or technologies that are not available in the list.
technical.targetUsersPlaceholder: e.g. Students, academic supervisors, company supervisors, administrators
technical.targetUsersHelper: This helps AI generate relevant actors and backlog items.

projectSettings.title: Project Specifications
projectSettings.description: Update the academic parameters and technical context used to initialize and generate your PFE workspace artifacts.
projectSettings.savedNotice: Project specifications have been updated and synchronized with your workspace.
projectSettings.academicBasicsDescription: Core academic degree, title, institution, and language settings.
projectSettings.projectContextDescription: Target problem formulation, project goals, deliverables, and host partner.
projectSettings.technicalDescription: Implementation choices used by generated requirements, backlog, and technical documentation.

projectTypeDescriptions.academic: University-led project focused on academic validation.
projectTypeDescriptions.internship: Company-hosted project solving a real business need.
projectTypeDescriptions.startup: Product-oriented idea with market and growth potential.
projectTypeDescriptions.research: Investigation-driven work with experiments or publications.
